scene.title: Scene
scene.importHint: Replaces the object of the scene. It is copied into the project when you save.

references.title: References
references.help: Images that guide the generation. One image is enough; several views of the same object improve the result.
references.dropHint: PNG, JPG or WebP · up to 20 MB and 16 MP
references.noBackgroundEngine: Install an engine that removes backgrounds
references.removeBackgroundView: Remove the background of the {{view}} view
references.viewsHint: One image per side of the same object. Multi-view engines use them all; single-image engines use the front.
references.reviewHint: Silhouette checks require a transparent background. Compare opposite views of the same object; warnings are approximate. Top views are excluded from height matching.
references.opaque: Remove the background before reviewing the silhouette
references.scaleWarning: The object occupies different heights across views (over 15%). Match heights before generation.
references.silhouetteWarning: Opposite views have different silhouette proportions (over 25%). Check that they show the same object.
references.projectionHint: Overlays the reference on a fixed orthographic camera. Align the silhouette using a uniform scale and offsets. This does not paint or change the mesh. Stop projection to orbit again.

inspector.title: Configuration

engine.title: Generation engine
engine.help: Local model that turns references into a 3D object.

quality.title: Quality
quality.help: Sampling steps of each profile. Use the gear to customize them.

scale.title: Physical scale
scale.help: Scales the result uniformly to a real height in meters.

retopology.title: Automatic retopology
retopology.help: Rebuilds a clean mesh with new UVs and transfers the color.

optimize.title: Optimize and LOD
optimize.help: Reduces triangles to a budget and creates up to three levels of detail.

inspect.title: Inspect mesh
inspect.help: Finds open borders, non-manifold edges and disconnected parts.

texture.title: AI texture
texture.help: Generates color and PBR maps for the model.

materials.title: Materials
materials.help: Edits base color, roughness, metalness, normal and AO maps.

paint.title: Paint 3D
paint.help: Paints, clones and restores color directly on the surface.

uv.title: UV
uv.help: Unwraps and packs UVs and exports a template.

normals.title: Normals
normals.help: Recalculates normals and bakes them from a detailed source.

proportions.title: Adjust proportions
proportions.help: Compares the silhouette with the references and corrects it.

projection.title: Reference projection
projection.help: Projects references with explicit cameras to fix details.

rig.title: Skeleton
rig.help: Creates and edits a humanoid skeleton with weights.

clips.title: Clips
clips.help: Library of animations to play, edit and export.

video.title: Motion from video
video.help: Captures body movement from a local video.

glb.title: Export GLB
glb.help: Writes the active version as a self-contained GLB.

lod.title: Levels of detail
lod.help: Exports each LOD as a separate file.

interchange.title: Engine packages
interchange.help: Prepares a validated folder for Blender, Unity or Godot with the active version, its LODs, tangents for normal maps, import instructions and a checksummed manifest.

textMotion.title: Motion from text
textMotion.help: Describes a movement and asks your Codex, Claude or Copilot CLI for a draft clip on the displayed rig. Only the description and the bone list are sent.

weights.title: Skin weights
weights.help: Reviews and adjusts how each bone deforms the mesh.

presets.title: Preset animations
presets.help: Idle, walk and run clips ready to apply.

timeline.title: Key editor
timeline.help: Edits bone rotations frame by frame on the timeline.

retarget.title: Apply to a character
retarget.help: Maps the bones of a rigged character and applies the clip to it.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.help: Describe an object. The image engine creates candidates; pick one and it becomes the reference for the 3D generation.

promptHistory.title: Prompt history
promptHistory.help: Prompts used in this project with their seeds. Reuse one to repeat or vary it.

multiView.title: Multiple views
multiView.help: Front, back, left and right references of the same object, plus an optional top view, for multi-view engines.

referenceReview.title: Reference review
referenceReview.help: Checks scale and silhouette of the references and matches their heights without stretching.

occlusion.title: Ambient occlusion
occlusion.help: Bakes ambient occlusion from the geometry into the occlusion map, keeping the mesh and its other maps intact.

mesh.retopologyPolicy: QuadriFlow targets a quad-face budget and regenerates UVs. The exported GLB is triangulated, up to twice that triangle count. Multiple materials, textured or complex materials and rigged models are rejected to prevent data loss.
mesh.previewHint: Changes create a preview linked to the original. Apply it in Versions to make it active.
mesh.uvPolicy: Unwrap and pack new UVs into the 0–1 area. Existing UVs are replaced in the preview. Textured or complex materials are rejected.
mesh.exportFailed: The UV template could not be exported.
mesh.bakeHint: The active variant is the low mesh. Bake a tangent-space normal map from a different detailed variant. Existing low-mesh UVs are required.
mesh.occlusionHint: Needs one mesh with UVs. The mesh, UVs and existing maps are kept byte for byte; only the occlusion map is added or replaced. More samples reduce noise and take longer.
